metadata.name: CSA Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) v4.0
metadata.description: The Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM) is a cybersecurity control framework for cloud computing, 197 control objectives across 17 domains. Synthetic paraphrase for pipeline testing — not the official CSA text.
metadata.framework_purpose: Provide a controls framework across 17 cloud security domains.
metadata.framework_scope: Cloud service providers and customers across IaaS, PaaS and SaaS.
metadata.target_audience: Cloud security architects, CISOs, auditors, GRC teams

sections: BCR: Business Continuity Management & Operational Resilience
DSP: Data Security & Privacy Lifecycle Management
SEF: Security Incident Management, E-Discovery & Cloud Forensics
STA: Supply Chain Management, Transparency & Accountability

domains: Security Incident Management, E-Discovery & Cloud Forensics
